-- ============================================================
-- Loyalty Card System â€” MySQL Schema
-- Run this once to set up the database manually (optional,
-- Hibernate will auto-create via ddl-auto=update)
-- ============================================================

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS loyalty_db
  CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

USE loyalty_db;

-- ============================================================
-- USERS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id          BIGINT          NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    email       VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password    VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,
    first_name  VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL,
    last_name   VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL,
    phone       VARCHAR(30)     UNIQUE,
    role        ENUM('CUSTOMER','BUSINESS_OWNER') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER',
    qr_code     VARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at  DATETIME        NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    INDEX idx_users_email  (email),
    INDEX idx_users_qr     (qr_code),
    INDEX idx_users_role   (role)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- BUSINESSES
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS businesses (
    id                  BIGINT          NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name                VARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    description         TEXT,
    logo_url            VARCHAR(500),
    stamps_required     INT             NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    reward_description  VARCHAR(500)    NOT NULL,
    owner_id            BIGINT          NOT NULL,
    created_at          DATETIME        NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_business_owner
        FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- LOYALTY CARDS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loyalty_cards (
    id              BIGINT  NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id         BIGINT  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    business_id     BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    total_stamps    INT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    current_stamps  INT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    completed_cards INT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status          ENUM('ACTIVE','COMPLETED','REWARD_PENDING') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_at      DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at      DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_card_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)     REFERENCES users(id)      ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_card_business
        FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX idx_card_user     (user_id),
    INDEX idx_card_business (business_id),
    INDEX idx_card_status   (status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- STAMPS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stamps (
    id              BIGINT  NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    loyalty_card_id BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    added_by_id     BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    note            VARCHAR(300),
    created_at      DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_stamp_card
        FOREIGN KEY (loyalty_card_id) REFERENCES loyalty_cards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_stamp_added_by
        FOREIGN KEY (added_by_id)     REFERENCES users(id)         ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    INDEX idx_stamp_card       (loyalty_card_id),
    INDEX idx_stamp_created_at (created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- REWARDS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rewards (
    id              BIGINT  NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    loyalty_card_id BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    description     VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    status          ENUM('AVAILABLE','REDEEMED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE',
    earned_at       DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    redeemed_at     DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_reward_card
        FOREIGN KEY (loyalty_card_id) REFERENCES loyalty_cards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX idx_reward_card   (loyalty_card_id),
    INDEX idx_reward_status (status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.2.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.loyalty</groupId>
    <artifactId>loyalty-backend</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <name>loyalty-backend</name>
    <description>Loyalty Card System Backend</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
        <jjwt.version>0.12.3</jjwt.version>
        <zxing.version>3.5.2</zxing.version>
        <lombok.version>1.18.44</lombok.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Spring Boot Starters -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-security</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- MySQL -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.mysql</groupId>
            <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- H2 (test only) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JWT -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-api</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-impl</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-jackson</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- QR Code Generation -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.zxing</groupId>
            <artifactId>core</artifactId>
            <version>${zxing.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.zxing</groupId>
            <artifactId>javase</artifactId>
            <version>${zxing.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Lombok -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Test -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.security</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-security-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.11.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>${java.version}</source>
                    <target>${java.version}</target>
                    <fork>true</fork>
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.2</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Allow Byte Buddy experimental support for newer JVM bytecodes -->
                    <argLine>-Dnet.bytebuddy.experimental=true</argLine>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <excludes>
                        <exclude>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                        </exclude>
                    </excludes>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

version: '3.9'

services:

  # â”€â”€ MySQL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  db:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: loyalty-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpassword
      MYSQL_DATABASE: loyalty_db
      MYSQL_USER: loyalty_user
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: loyalty_pass
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./backend/src/main/resources/schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/schema.sql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-u", "root", "-prootpassword"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # â”€â”€ Spring Boot Backend â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: loyalty-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:mysql://db:3306/loyalty_db?useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&serverTimezone=UTC
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: loyalty_user
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: loyalty_pass
      APP_JWT_SECRET: 404E635266556A586E3272357538782F413F4428472B4B6250645367566B5970
      APP_JWT_EXPIRATION: 86400000
      APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/actuator/health"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # â”€â”€ Angular Frontend â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: loyalty-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "80:80"

volumes:
  mysql_data:

ResponseEntity\u003c?\u003e getRedemptions(\n            @AuthenticationPrincipal User admin,\n            @RequestParam(required = false, defaultValue = \"pending\") String status) {\n\n        try {\n            List\u003cMap\u003cString, Object\u003e\u003e result = new ArrayList\u003c\u003e();\n\n            // Buscar rewards de tarjetas\n            List\u003cReward\u003e cardRewards;\n            if (\"pending\".equals(status)) {\n                cardRewards = rewardRepository.findByStatus(Reward.RewardStatus.REQUESTED);\n            } else if (\"approved\".equals(status)) {\n                cardRewards = rewardRepository.findByStatus(Reward.RewardStatus.REDEEMED);\n            } else {\n                cardRewards = new ArrayList\u003c\u003e();\n            }\n\n            for (Reward r : cardRewards) {\n                LoyaltyCard card = r.getLoyaltyCard();\n                result.add(Map.of(\n                        \"id\", r.getId(),\n                        \"type\", \"CARD\",\n                        \"customerName\", card.getUser().getFirstName() + \" \" + card.getUser().getLastName(),\n                        \"customerEmail\", card.getUser().getEmail(),\n         }\n\n            // Buscar rewards de fidelidad\n            List\u003cFidelityReward\u003e fidelityRewards;\n            if (\"pending\".equals(status)) {\n                fidelityRewards = (FidelityReward fr : fidelityRewards) {\n                LoyaltyCard card = fr.getLoyaltyCard();\n                result.add(Map.of(\n                        \"id\", fr.getId(),\n                        \"type\", \"FIDELITY\",\n                        \"customerName\", card.getUser().getFirstName() + \" \" + card.getUser().getLastName(),\n                        \"customerEmail\", card.getUser().getEmail(),\n                        \"description\", fr.getDescription(),\n                        \"requestedAt\", fr.getRequestedAt(),\n                        \"status\", fr.getStatus().name(),\n                        \"cardsRequired\", fr.getTier().getCardsRequired()\n                ));\n            }\n\n            return ResponseEntity.ok(result);\n\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of(\"error\", e.getMessage()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/{id}/approve\")\n    public Object\u003e body) {\n\n        try {\n            // Intentar en Reward primero\n            Reward reward = rewardRepository.findById(id).orElse(null);\n            if (reward != null) {\n                if (reward.getStatus() != Reward.RewardStatus.REQUESTED) {\n                    return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of(\"error\", \"Reward not in requested state\"));\n                }\n                reward.setStatus(Reward.RewardStatus.REDEEMED);\n                reward.setApprovedAt(LocalDateTime.now());\n                reward.setRedeemedAt(LocalDateTime.now());\n                rewardRepository.save(reward);\n                return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(\"message\", \"Reward approved\"));\n            }\n\n            // Si no, buscar en FidelityReward\n            FidelityReward fidelityReward = fidelityRewardRepository.findById(id).orElse(null);\n            if (fidelityReward != null) {\n                if (fidelityReward.getStatus() != fidelityReward.setRedeemedAt(LocalDateTime.now());\n                fidelityRewardRepository.save(fidelityReward);\n                return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(\"message\", \"Fidelity reward e.getMessage()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/{id}/reject\")\n    public ResponseEntity\u003c?\u003e rejectRedemption(\n            @AuthenticationPrincipal User admin,\n            @PathVariable Long id,\n            @RequestBody(required = false) Map\u003cString, String\u003e body) {\n\n        try {\n            String reason = body != null ? body.get(\"reason\") : null;\n\n            // Intentar en Reward primero\n            Reward reward = rewardRepository.findById(id).orElse(null);\n            if (reward != null) {\n                if (reward.getStatus() != Reward.RewardStatus.REQUESTED) {\n                    return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of(\"error\", \"Reward not in requested state\"));\n                }\n                reward.setStatus(Reward.RewardStatus.AVAILABLE);\n                reward.setRejectedAt(LocalDateTime.now());\n                reward.setRejectionReason(reason);\n                         "value":  "package com.loyalty.security;\n\nimport jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;\nimport jakarta.servlet.ServletException;\nimport jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;\nimport jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;\nimport org.springframework.lang.NonNull;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;\nimport org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\nimport org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\n\n@Component\npublic class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {\n\n    private final JwtService jwtService;\n    private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;\n\n    public JwtAuthenticationFilter(JwtService jwtService, UserDetailsService userDetailsService) {\n        this.jwtService = jwtService;\n        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    protected void doFilterInternal(\n            @NonNull HttpServletRequest request,\n            @NonNull HttpServletResponse response,\n            @NonNull FilterChain filterChain\n    ) throws ServletException, IOException {\n        final String authHeader = request.getHeader(\"Authorization\");\n        final String jwt;\n        final String userEmail;\n\n        if (authHeader == null || !authHeader.startsWith(\"Bearer \")) {\n            filterChain.doFilter(request, response);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        jwt = authHeader.substring(7);\n        userEmail = jwtService.extractUsername(jwt);\n\n        if (userEmail != null \u0026\u0026 SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication() == null) {\n            UserDetails userDetails = this.userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(userEmail);\n            if (jwtService.isTokenValid(jwt, userDetails)) {\n                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authToken = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(\n                        userDetails, null, userDetails.getAuthorities()\n                );\n                authToken.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request));\n                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authToken);\n            }\n        }\n\n        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.security;\n\nimport io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;\nimport io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;\nimport io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport javax.crypto.SecretKey;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.Date;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.function.Function;\n\n@Service\npublic class JwtService {\n\n    @Value(\"${app.jwt.secret}\")\n    private String secretKey;\n\n    @Value(\"${app.jwt.expiration}\")\n    private long jwtExpiration;\n\n    public String extractUsername(String token) {\n        return extractClaim(token, Claims::getSubject);\n    }\n\n    public \u003cT\u003e T extractClaim(String token, Function\u003cClaims, T\u003e claimsResolver) {\n        final Claims claims = extractAllClaims(token);\n        return claimsResolver.apply(claims);\n    }\n\n    public String generateToken(UserDetails userDetails) {\n        return generateToken(new HashMap\u003c\u003e(), userDetails);\n    }\n\n    public String generateToken(Map\u003cString, Object\u003e extraClaims, UserDetails userDetails) {\n        return buildToken(extraClaims, userDetails, jwtExpiration);\n    }\n\n    private String buildToken(Map\u003cString, Object\u003e extraClaims, UserDetails userDetails, long expiration) {\n        return Jwts.builder()\n                .claims(extraClaims)\n                .subject(userDetails.getUsername())\n                .issuedAt(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis()))\n                .expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expiration))\n                .signWith(getSignInKey())\n                .compact();\n    }\n\n    public boolean isTokenValid(String token, UserDetails userDetails) {\n        final String username = extractUsername(token);\n        return username.equals(userDetails.getUsername()) \u0026\u0026 !isTokenExpired(token);\n    }\n\n    private boolean isTokenExpired(String token) {\n        return extractExpiration(token).before(new Date());\n    }\n\n    private Date extractExpiration(String token) {\n        return extractClaim(token, Claims::getExpiration);\n    }\n\n    private Claims extractAllClaims(String token) {\n        return Jwts.parser()\n                .verifyWith(getSignInKey())\n                .build()\n                .parseSignedClaims(token)\n                .getPayload();\n    }\n\n    private SecretKey getSignInKey() {\n        byte[] keyBytes = secretKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(keyBytes);\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport com.loyalty.dto.AuthDto;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.Business;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.LoyaltyCard;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.User;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.BusinessRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.LoyaltyCardRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.UserRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.security.JwtService;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\n@Service\npublic class AuthService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final BusinessRepository businessRepository;\n    private final LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository;\n    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;\n    private final JwtService jwtService;\n    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;\n    private final QrCodeService qrCodeService;\n\n    public AuthService(UserRepository userRepository, BusinessRepository businessRepository, LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository, PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder, JwtService jwtService, AuthenticationManager authenticationManager, QrCodeService qrCodeService) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.businessRepository = businessRepository;\n        this.loyaltyCardRepository = loyaltyCardRepository;\n        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;\n        this.jwtService = jwtService;\n        this.authenticationManager = authenticationManager;\n        this.qrCodeService = qrCodeService;\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public AuthDto.AuthResponse register(AuthDto.RegisterRequest request) {\n        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(request.getEmail())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Email already registered\");\n        }\n\n        User.Role role = User.Role.valueOf(request.getRole().toUpperCase());\n        String qrCodeId = qrCodeService.generateQrCodeId();\n\n        User user = User.builder()\n                .email(request.getEmail())\n                .password(passwordEncoder.encode(request.getPassword()))\n                .firstName(request.getFirstName())\n                .lastName(request.getLastName())\n                .phone(request.getPhone())\n                .role(role)\n                .qrCode(qrCodeId)\n                .build();\n\n        User savedUser = userRepository.save(user);\n\n        if (role == User.Role.CUSTOMER) {\n            // Get the default business (first business, or create one)\n            Business business = businessRepository.findAll().stream()\n                    .findFirst()\n                    .orElseGet(() -\u003e createDefaultBusiness(savedUser));\n\n            LoyaltyCard loyaltyCard = LoyaltyCard.builder()\n                    .user(savedUser)\n                    .business(business)\n                    .totalStamps(business.getStampsRequired())\n                    .currentStamps(0)\n                    .completedCards(0)\n                    .status(LoyaltyCard.CardStatus.ACTIVE)\n                    .build();\n\n            loyaltyCardRepository.save(loyaltyCard);\n        } else if (role == User.Role.BUSINESS_OWNER) {\n            Business business = Business.builder()\n                    .name(request.getFirstName() + \"\u0027s Coffee Shop\")\n                    .description(\"Welcome to our loyalty program!\")\n                    .stampsRequired(10)\n                    .rewardDescription(\"Buy 10 coffees, get 1 FREE!\")\n                    .owner(savedUser)\n                    .build();\n            businessRepository.save(business);\n        }\n\n        String jwtToken = jwtService.generateToken(savedUser);\n        return new AuthDto.AuthResponse(\n                jwtToken, savedUser.getEmail(),\n                savedUser.getFirstName(), savedUser.getLastName(),\n                savedUser.getRole().name(), savedUser.getId()\n        );\n    }\n\n    public AuthDto.AuthResponse login(AuthDto.LoginRequest request) {\n        authenticationManager.authenticate(\n                new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(request.getEmail(), request.getPassword())\n        );\n\n        User user = userRepository.findByEmail(request.getEmail())\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new IllegalArgumentException(\"User not found\"));\n\n        String jwtToken = jwtService.generateToken(user);\n        return new AuthDto.AuthResponse(\n                jwtToken, user.getEmail(),\n                user.getFirstName(), user.getLastName(),\n                user.getRole().name(), user.getId()\n        );\n    }\n\n    private Business createDefaultBusiness(User owner) {\n        Business business = Business.builder()\n                .name(\"Loyalty Coffee Shop\")\n                .description(\"Your neighborhood coffee shop\")\n                .stampsRequired(10)\n                .rewardDescription(\"Buy 10 coffees, get 1 FREE!\")\n                .owner(owner)\n                .build();\n        return businessRepository.save(business);\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport com.loyalty.dto.BusinessDto;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.Business;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.User;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.BusinessRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.LoyaltyCardRepository;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\n@Service\npublic class BusinessService {\n\n    private final BusinessRepository businessRepository;\n    private final LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository;\n\n    public BusinessService(BusinessRepository businessRepository, LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository) {\n        this.businessRepository = businessRepository;\n        this.loyaltyCardRepository = loyaltyCardRepository;\n    }\n\n    public BusinessDto getMyBusiness(User owner) {\n        Business business = businessRepository.findByOwner(owner)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"No business found for this owner\"));\n        return mapToDto(business);\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public BusinessDto updateBusiness(User owner, BusinessDto request) {\n        Business business = businessRepository.findByOwner(owner)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"No business found for this owner\"));\n\n        if (request.getName() != null)              business.setName(request.getName());\n        if (request.getDescription() != null)       business.setDescription(request.getDescription());\n        if (request.getLogoUrl() != null)           business.setLogoUrl(request.getLogoUrl());\n        if (request.getRewardDescription() != null) business.setRewardDescription(request.getRewardDescription());\n        if (request.getStampsRequired() != null \u0026\u0026 request.getStampsRequired() \u003e 0) {\n            business.setStampsRequired(request.getStampsRequired());\n        }\n\n        Business saved = businessRepository.save(business);\n        return mapToDto(saved);\n    }\n\n    private BusinessDto mapToDto(Business business) {\n        long customerCount = loyaltyCardRepository.findAll().stream()\n                .filter(c -\u003e c.getBusiness().getId().equals(business.getId()))\n                .count();\n\n        return BusinessDto.builder()\n                .id(business.getId())\n                .name(business.getName())\n                .description(business.getDescription())\n                .logoUrl(business.getLogoUrl())\n                .stampsRequired(business.getStampsRequired())\n                .rewardDescription(business.getRewardDescription())\n                .ownerId(business.getOwner().getId())\n                .ownerName(business.getOwner().getFirstName() + \" \" + business.getOwner().getLastName())\n                .totalCustomers((int) customerCount)\n                .createdAt(business.getCreatedAt())\n                .build();\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;\nimport org.springframework.util.StringUtils;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.nio.file.Paths;\nimport java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\n@Service\npublic class FileStorageService {\n\n    @Value(\"${file.upload-dir}\")\n    private String uploadDir;\n\n    /**\n     * Guarda un archivo en el servidor\n     * @param file El archivo a guardar\n     * @param subfolder Subcarpeta (logos o backgrounds)\n     * @return La URL pÃºblica del archivo\n     * @throws IOException Si hay error al guardar\n     */\n    public String storeFile(MultipartFile file, String subfolder) throws IOException {\n        // Crear el directorio si no existe\n        Path uploadPath = Paths.get(uploadDir, subfolder);\n        if (!Files.exists(uploadPath)) {\n            Files.createDirectories(uploadPath);\n        }\n\n        // Generar nombre Ãºnico para evitar conflictos\n        String originalFilename = StringUtils.cleanPath(file.getOriginalFilename());\n        String extension = \"\";\n        if (originalFilename.contains(\".\")) {\n            extension = originalFilename.substring(originalFilename.lastIndexOf(\".\"));\n        } else {\n            extension = \".png\"; // default\n        }\n\n        String filename = UUID.randomUUID().toString() + extension;\n\n        // Guardar el archivo\n        Path filePath = uploadPath.resolve(filename);\n        Files.copy(file.getInputStream(), filePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);\n\n        // Retornar la URL pÃºblica (relativa)\n        return \"/uploads/\" + subfolder + \"/\" + filename;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Elimina un archivo del servidor\n     * @param fileUrl La URL del archivo a eliminar\n     */\n    public void deleteFile(String fileUrl) {\n        if (fileUrl == null || fileUrl.isEmpty()) return;\n\n        try {\n            // Extraer nombre del archivo de la URL\n            String filename = fileUrl.substring(fileUrl.lastIndexOf(\"/\") + 1);\n            String subfolder = fileUrl.contains(\"/logos/\") ? \"logos\" : \"backgrounds\";\n\n            Path filePath = Paths.get(uploadDir, subfolder, filename);\n            Files.deleteIfExists(filePath);\n        } catch (IOException e) {\n            // Solo loguear, no interrumpir flujo\n            System.err.println(\"Error deleting file: \" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport com.loyalty.dto.CustomerDto;\nimport com.loyalty.dto.LoyaltyCardDto;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.*;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.*;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@Service\npublic class LoyaltyCardService {\n\n    private final FidelityTierRepository fidelityTierRepository;\n    private final FidelityRewardRepository fidelityRewardRepository;\n    private final LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository;\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final StampRepository stampRepository;\n    private final RewardRepository rewardRepository;\n    private final QrCodeService qrCodeService;\n\n    // âœ… ÃšNICO CONSTRUCTOR\n    public LoyaltyCardService(\n            LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository,\n            UserRepository userRepository,\n            StampRepository stampRepository,\n            RewardRepository rewardRepository,\n            QrCodeService qrCodeService,\n            FidelityTierRepository fidelityTierRepository,\n            FidelityRewardRepository fidelityRewardRepository\n    ) {\n        this.loyaltyCardRepository = loyaltyCardRepository;\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.stampRepository = stampRepository;\n        this.rewardRepository = rewardRepository;\n        this.qrCodeService = qrCodeService;\n        this.fidelityTierRepository = fidelityTierRepository;\n        this.fidelityRewardRepository = fidelityRewardRepository;\n    }\n\n    public LoyaltyCardDto getLoyaltyCard(Long userId) {\n        LoyaltyCard card = loyaltyCardRepository.findByUserId(userId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"Loyalty card not found\"));\n        return mapToDto(card);\n    }\n\n    public String getQrCodeImage(Long userId) {\n        User user = userRepository.findById(userId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"User not found\"));\n        return qrCodeService.generateQrCodeBase64(user.getQrCode());\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public LoyaltyCardDto addStamp(Long userId, String note, User addedBy) {\n        LoyaltyCard card = loyaltyCardRepository.findByUserId(userId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"Loyalty card not found\"));\n\n        Stamp stamp = Stamp.builder()\n                .loyaltyCard(card)\n                .addedBy(addedBy)\n                .note(note)\n                .build();\n\n        stampRepository.save(stamp);\n        card.setCurrentStamps(card.getCurrentStamps() + 1);\n\n        if (card.getCurrentStamps() \u003e= card.getTotalStamps()) {\n            Reward reward = Reward.builder()\n                    .loyaltyCard(card)\n                    .description(card.getBusiness().getRewardDescription())\n                    .status(Reward.RewardStatus.AVAILABLE)\n                    .build();\n            rewardRepository.save(reward);\n\n            card.setCompletedCards(card.getCompletedCards() + 1);\n            card.setCurrentStamps(0);\n            card.setStatus(LoyaltyCard.CardStatus.REWARD_PENDING);\n\n            // âœ… Verificar recompensas por fidelidad\n            checkAndGrantFidelityRewards(card);\n        }\n\n        loyaltyCardRepository.save(card);\n        return mapToDto(card);\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public LoyaltyCardDto scanQrAndAddStamp(String qrCode, String note, User addedBy) {\n        User customer = userRepository.findByQrCode(qrCode)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"Invalid QR code\"));\n        return addStamp(customer.getId(), note, addedBy);\n    }\n\n    public List\u003cCustomerDto\u003e getAllCustomers() {\n        return userRepository.findAllCustomers().stream()\n                .map(this::mapUserToCustomerDto)\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n    }\n\n    public List\u003cCustomerDto\u003e searchCustomers(String query) {\n        return userRepository.searchCustomers(query).stream()\n                .map(this::mapUserToCustomerDto)\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n    }\n\n    private LoyaltyCardDto mapToDto(LoyaltyCard card) {\n        List\u003cLoyaltyCardDto.StampDto\u003e recentStamps = stampRepository\n                .findByLoyaltyCardIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(card.getId())\n                .stream()\n                .limit(10)\n                .map(s -\u003e LoyaltyCardDto.StampDto.builder()\n                        .id(s.getId())\n                        .addedByName(s.getAddedBy().getFirstName() + \" \" + s.getAddedBy().getLastName())\n                        .note(s.getNote())\n                        .createdAt(s.getCreatedAt())\n                        .build())\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        List\u003cLoyaltyCardDto.RewardDto\u003e rewards = rewardRepository\n                .findByLoyaltyCardId(card.getId())\n                .stream()\n                .map(r -\u003e LoyaltyCardDto.RewardDto.builder()\n                        .id(r.getId())\n                        .description(r.getDescription())\n                        .status(r.getStatus().name())\n                        .earnedAt(r.getEarnedAt())\n                        .redeemedAt(r.getRedeemedAt())\n                        .build())\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        // âœ… NUEVO: Obtener recompensas de fidelidad\n        List\u003cLoyaltyCardDto.FidelityRewardDto\u003e fidelityRewards = fidelityRewardRepository\n                .findByLoyaltyCardOrderByEarnedAtDesc(card)\n                .stream()\n                .map(fr -\u003e LoyaltyCardDto.FidelityRewardDto.builder()\n                        .id(fr.getId())\n                        .description(fr.getDescription())\n                        .status(fr.getStatus().name())\n                        .earnedAt(fr.getEarnedAt())\n                        .redeemedAt(fr.getRedeemedAt())\n                        .cardsRequired(fr.getTier().getCardsRequired())\n                        .build())\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        return LoyaltyCardDto.builder()\n                .id(card.getId())\n                .userId(card.getUser().getId())\n                .customerName(card.getUser().getFirstName() + \" \" + card.getUser().getLastName())\n                .customerEmail(card.getUser().getEmail())\n                .qrCode(card.getUser().getQrCode())\n                .businessName(card.getBusiness().getName())\n                .rewardDescription(card.getBusiness().getRewardDescription())\n                .currentStamps(card.getCurrentStamps())\n                .totalStamps(card.getTotalStamps())\n                .completedCards(card.getCompletedCards())\n                .status(card.getStatus().name())\n                .createdAt(card.getCreatedAt())\n                .updatedAt(card.getUpdatedAt())\n                .recentStamps(recentStamps)\n                .rewards(rewards)\n                .fidelityRewards(fidelityRewards)  // â† NUEVO\n                .build();\n    }\n\n    private void checkAndGrantFidelityRewards(LoyaltyCard card) {\n        List\u003cFidelityTier\u003e eligibleTiers = fidelityTierRepository.findEligibleTiers(\n                card.getBusiness(),\n                card.getCompletedCards()\n        );\n\n        for (FidelityTier tier : eligibleTiers) {\n            boolean alreadyGranted = fidelityRewardRepository\n                    .findByLoyaltyCardAndStatus(card, FidelityReward.RewardStatus.AVAILABLE)\n                    .stream()\n                    .anyMatch(r -\u003e r.getTier().getId().equals(tier.getId()));\n\n            if (!alreadyGranted) {\n                FidelityReward fidelityReward = new FidelityReward();\n                fidelityReward.setLoyaltyCard(card);\n                fidelityReward.setTier(tier);\n                fidelityReward.setDescription(tier.getRewardDescription());\n                fidelityReward.setStatus(FidelityReward.RewardStatus.AVAILABLE);\n                fidelityRewardRepository.save(fidelityReward);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private CustomerDto mapUserToCustomerDto(User user) {\n        LoyaltyCard card = loyaltyCardRepository.findByUserId(user.getId()).orElse(null);\n        return CustomerDto.builder()\n                .id(user.getId())\n                .email(user.getEmail())\n                .firstName(user.getFirstName())\n                .lastName(user.getLastName())\n                .phone(user.getPhone())\n                .qrCode(user.getQrCode())\n                .currentStamps(card != null ? card.getCurrentStamps() : 0)\n                .totalStamps(card != null ? card.getTotalStamps() : 0)\n                .completedCards(card != null ? card.getCompletedCards() : 0)\n                .cardStatus(card != null ? card.getStatus().name() : \"NO_CARD\")\n                .memberSince(user.getCreatedAt())\n                .build();\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport com.google.zxing.BarcodeFormat;\nimport com.google.zxing.EncodeHintType;\nimport com.google.zxing.WriterException;\nimport com.google.zxing.client.j2se.MatrixToImageWriter;\nimport com.google.zxing.common.BitMatrix;\nimport com.google.zxing.qrcode.QRCodeWriter;\nimport com.google.zxing.qrcode.decoder.ErrorCorrectionLevel;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\n@Service\npublic class QrCodeService {\n\n    public String generateQrCodeId() {\n        return UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace(\"-\", \"\").substring(0, 16).toUpperCase();\n    }\n\n    public String generateQrCodeBase64(String content) {\n        try {\n            QRCodeWriter qrCodeWriter = new QRCodeWriter();\n            Map\u003cEncodeHintType, Object\u003e hints = new HashMap\u003c\u003e();\n            hints.put(EncodeHintType.ERROR_CORRECTION, ErrorCorrectionLevel.H);\n            hints.put(EncodeHintType.MARGIN, 2);\n\n            BitMatrix bitMatrix = qrCodeWriter.encode(content, BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE, 300, 300, hints);\n\n            ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();\n            MatrixToImageWriter.writeToStream(bitMatrix, \"PNG\", outputStream);\n            byte[] qrBytes = outputStream.toByteArray();\n\n            return \"data:image/png;base64,\" + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(qrBytes);\n        } catch (WriterException | IOException e) {\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"Failed to generate QR code\", e);\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

                        "value":  "package com.loyalty.service;\n\nimport com.loyalty.dto.AuthDto;\nimport com.loyalty.dto.CustomerDto;\nimport com.loyalty.dto.UserManagementDto;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.Business;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.LoyaltyCard;\nimport com.loyalty.entity.User;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.BusinessRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.LoyaltyCardRepository;\nimport com.loyalty.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@Service\npublic class UserManagementService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final BusinessRepository businessRepository;\n    private final LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository;\n    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;\n    private final QrCodeService qrCodeService;\n\n    public UserManagementService(UserRepository userRepository,\n                                  BusinessRepository businessRepository,\n                                  LoyaltyCardRepository loyaltyCardRepository,\n                                  PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,\n                                  QrCodeService qrCodeService) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.businessRepository = businessRepository;\n        this.loyaltyCardRepository = loyaltyCardRepository;\n        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;\n        this.qrCodeService = qrCodeService;\n    }\n\n    // List ALL users (customers + admins)\n    public List\u003cUserManagementDto\u003e getAllUsers() {\n        return userRepository.findAll().stream()\n                .map(this::toDto)\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n    }\n\n    // Create a new user with any role (admin only)\n    @Transactional\n    public UserManagementDto createUser(UserManagementDto.CreateRequest request) {\n        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(request.getEmail())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Email already registered\");\n        }\n\n        User.Role role = User.Role.valueOf(request.getRole().toUpperCase());\n        String qrCodeId = qrCodeService.generateQrCodeId();\n\n        User user = User.builder()\n                .email(request.getEmail())\n                .password(passwordEncoder.encode(request.getPassword()))\n                .firstName(request.getFirstName())\n                .lastName(request.getLastName())\n                .phone(request.getPhone())\n                .role(role)\n                .qrCode(qrCodeId)\n                .build();\n\n        User saved = userRepository.save(user);\n\n        if (role == User.Role.CUSTOMER) {\n            Business business = businessRepository.findAll().stream()\n                    .findFirst()\n                    .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"No business configured yet\"));\n\n            LoyaltyCard card = LoyaltyCard.builder()\n                    .user(saved)\n                    .business(business)\n                    .totalStamps(business.getStampsRequired())\n                    .currentStamps(0)\n                    .completedCards(0)\n                    .status(LoyaltyCard.CardStatus.ACTIVE)\n                    .build();\n            loyaltyCardRepository.save(card);\n\n        } else if (role == User.Role.BUSINESS_OWNER) {\n            Business business = Business.builder()\n                    .name(request.getFirstName() + \"\u0027s Coffee Shop\")\n                    .description(\"Welcome to our loyalty program!\")\n                    .stampsRequired(10)\n                    .rewardDescription(\"Buy 10 coffees, get 1 FREE!\")\n                    .owner(saved)\n                    .build();\n            businessRepository.save(business);\n        }\n\n        return toDto(saved);\n    }\n\n    // Update role of existing user\n    @Transactional\n    public UserManagementDto updateUserRole(Long userId, String newRole) {\n        User user = userRepository.findById(userId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"User not found\"));\n        user.setRole(User.Role.valueOf(newRole.toUpperCase()));\n        return toDto(userRepository.save(user));\n    }\n\n    // Delete user\n    @Transactional\n    public void deleteUser(Long userId, User requestingAdmin) {\n        if (userId.equals(requestingAdmin.getId())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"You cannot delete your own account\");\n        }\n        User user = userRepository.findById(userId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -\u003e new RuntimeException(\"User not found\"));\n        userRepository.delete(user);\n    }\n\n    private UserManagementDto toDto(User user) {\n        UserManagementDto dto = new UserManagementDto();\n        dto.setId(user.getId());\n        dto.setEmail(user.getEmail());\n        dto.setFirstName(user.getFirstName());\n        dto.setLastName(user.getLastName());\n        dto.setPhone(user.getPhone());\n        dto.setRole(user.getRole().name());\n        dto.setCreatedAt(user.getCreatedAt());\n        return dto;\n    }\n}\n",

AuthDto.RegisterRequest request = new AuthDto.RegisterRequest();\n        request.setEmail(\"newuser@test.com\");\n        request.setPassword(\"password123\");\n        request.setFirstName(\"Alice\");\n        request.setLastName(\"Smith\");\n        request.setPhone(\"555-1234\");\n        request.setRole(\"CUSTOMER\");\n\n .andExpect(status().isOk())\n                .andExpect(jsonPath(\"$.token\").isNotEmpty())\n                .andExpect(jsonPath(\"$.email\").value(\"newuser@test.com\"))\n                .andExpect(jsonPath(\"$.role\").value(\"CUSTOMER\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void shouldRegisterNewBusinessOwner() throws Exception {\n        AuthDto.RegisterRequest request = new request.setLastName(\"Owner\");\n        request.setRole(\"BUSINESS_OWNER\");\n\n        mockMvc.perform(post(\"/api/auth/register\")\n                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)\n                .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(request)))\n                .andExpect(status().isOk())\n                .andExpect(jsonPath(\"$.role\").value(\"BUSINESS_OWNER\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void shouldRejectDuplicateEmail() throws Exception {\n        AuthDto.RegisterRequest request = new AuthDto.RegisterRequest();\n        request.setEmail(\"duplicate@test.com\");\n        request.setPassword(\"password123\");\n        request.setFirstName(\"Test\");\n        request.setLastName(\"User\");\n        request.setRole(\"CUSTOMER\");\n\n        // Register once\n        mockMvc.perform(post(\"/api/auth/register\")\n                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)\n                .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(request)))\n                .andExpect(status().isOk());\n\n        // Try to register again with same email\n        mockMvc.perform(post(\"/api/auth/register\")\n                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)\n void shouldLoginWithValidCredentials() throws Exception {\n        // First register\n        AuthDto.RegisterRequest registerRequest = new AuthDto.RegisterRequest();\n JSON.parse(user) : null;\n  }\n\n  isLoggedIn(): boolean {\n    return !!this.getToken();\n  }\n\n  getRole(): string | null {\n    return this.getUser()?.role ?? null;\n  }\n\n  isCustomer(): boolean {\n    return this.getRole() === \u0027CUSTOMER\u0027;\n  }\n\n  isAdmin(): boolean {\n    return this.getRole() === \u0027BUSINESS_OWNER\u0027;\n  }\n\n  private saveSession(res: AuthResponse): void {\n    localStorage.setItem(\u0027token\u0027, res.token);\n    localStorage.setItem(\u0027user\u0027, JSON.stringify(res));\n  }\n}\n",

interface AppTheme {\n  id?: number;\n  mode: ThemeMode;\n  primaryColor: string;\n  secondaryColor: string;\n  accentColor: string;\n  fontFamily: string;\n  appName: string;\n  logoUrl: string;\n  logoSize: number;\n  nameSize: number;\n  navbarTextColor: string;\n  logoPosition: \u0027top-left\u0027 | \u0027centered\u0027 | \u0027header\u0027;\n  backgroundUrl: string;\n  backgroundSize:  secondaryColor: \u0027#1A1A2E\u0027,\n  accentColor: \u0027#FFD166\u0027,\n  fontFamily: \u0027Syne\u0027,\n  appName: \u0027LoyaltyCard\u0027,\n  logoUrl: \u0027\u0027,\n  logoSize: 32,\n  nameSize: 85,\n};\n\n@Injectable({ providedIn: \u0027root\u0027 })\nexport class ThemeService {\n  private theme: AppTheme = { ...DEFAULT_THEME };\n  private apiUrl = `${environment.apiUrl}/admin/theme`;\n\n  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {\n    this.loadFromServer();\n  }\n\n  async loadFromServer() {\n    try {\n      const serverTheme = await firstValueFrom(this.http.get\u003cAppTheme\u003e(this.apiUrl));\n      this.theme = { ...DEFAULT_THEME, ...serverTheme };\n      this.apply();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\u0027Error loading theme from server\u0027, error);\n      this.loadFromLocalStorage();\n    }\n  }\n\n  private loadFromLocalStorage() {\n    const saved = localStorage.getItem(\u0027app-theme\u0027);\n    if (saved) {\n      try {\n        this.theme = { ...DEFAULT_THEME, ...JSON.parse(saved) };\n      } catch {\n        this.theme = { ...DEFAULT_THEME };\n      }\n    }\n    this.apply();\n  }\n\n  getTheme(): AppTheme {\n    return { ...this.theme };\n  }\n\n  // SOLO APLICA VISUALMENTE, NO GUARDA\n  applyTheme(partial: Partial\u003cAppTheme\u003e): void {\n    this.theme = { ...this.theme, this.theme.primaryColor,\n      secondaryColor: this.theme.secondaryColor,\n      accentColor: this.theme.accentColor,\n      fontFamily: this.theme.fontFamily,\n      appName: this.theme.appName,\n      logoSize: this.theme.logoSize,\n      nameSize: this.theme.nameSize,\n      navbarTextColor: this.theme.navbarTextColor,\n      backgroundSize: this.theme.backgroundSize,\n      backgroundBlur: \u0027#FFAB40\u0027 },\n    };\n    this.theme = { ...this.theme, ...presets[mode], mode };\n    this.apply();\n    // No guardamos automÃ¡ticamente\n  }\n\n  resetDefaults(): void {\n    this.theme = { ...DEFAULT_THEME };\n    this.apply();\n    // No guardamos automÃ¡ticamente\n  }\n\n  async uploadLogo(file: File): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    const formData = new FormData();\n    formData.append(\u0027file\u0027, file);\n\n    const response = await firstValueFrom(\n      this.http.post\u003c{ url: string }\u003e(`${this.apiUrl}/upload-logo`, formData)\n    );\n\n    this.theme.logoUrl = response.url;\n    this.apply();\n    return response.url;\n  }\n\n  async uploadBackground(file: File): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    const formData = new FormData();\n    formData.append(\u0027file\u0027, file);\n\n    const response = await firstValueFrom(\n      this.http.post\u003c{ url: string }\u003e(`${this.apiUrl}/upload-background`, formData)\n    );\n\n    this.theme.backgroundUrl = response.url;\n    this.apply();\n    return response.url;\n  }\n\n  removeLogo() {\n    this.http.delete(`${this.apiUrl}/remove-logo`).subscribe({\n      next: () =\u003e    this.http.delete(`${this.apiUrl}/remove-background`).subscribe({\n      next: () =\u003e {\n        this.theme.backgroundUrl = \u0027\u0027;\n        this.apply();\n      },\n      error: (err) root.setAttribute(\u0027data-theme\u0027, t.mode);\n    root.style.setProperty(\u0027--primary\u0027, t.primaryColor);\n    root.style.setProperty(\u0027--primary-dark\u0027, root.style.setProperty(\u0027--surface-2\u0027, `rgba(30, 30, 53, ${opacity})`);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--border\u0027, \u0027#2A2A45\u0027);\n root.style.setProperty(\u0027--text-muted\u0027, \u0027#5A5A80\u0027);\n    } else {\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--bg\u0027, \u0027#F8F7F4\u0027);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--surface\u0027, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${opacity})`);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--surface-2\u0027, `rgba(243, 242, 239, ${opacity})`);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--border\u0027, \u0027#E8E6E1\u0027);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--text-primary\u0027, \u0027#1A1A2E\u0027);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--text-secondary\u0027, \u0027#6B6B7B\u0027);\n      root.style.setProperty(\u0027--text-muted\u0027, \u0027#9B9BAB\u0027);\n    }\n\n    const fontMap: Record\u003cstring, string\u003e = {\n      \u0027Syne\u0027: \"\u0027Syne\u0027, sans-serif\",\n      \u0027DM Sans\u0027: \"\u0027DM Sans\u0027, sans-serif\",\n      \u0027Outfit\u0027: \"\u0027Outfit\u0027, sans-serif\",\n      \u0027Space Grotesk\u0027: \"\u0027Space Grotesk\u0027, sans-serif\",\n      \u0027Plus Jakarta Sans\u0027: \"\u0027Plus Jakarta Sans\u0027, sans-serif\",\n    };\n    root.style.setProperty(\u0027--font-display\u0027, fontMap[t.fontFamily] || fontMap[\u0027Syne\u0027]);\n\n    if (t.backgroundUrl) {\n      // Usar getImageUrl para la URL del background\n      const bgUrl = this.getImageUrl(t.backgroundUrl);\n      const bgValue = t.backgroundBlur\n        ? `linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.4), rgba(0,0,0,0.4)), url(\u0027${bgUrl}\u0027)`\n        : `url(\u0027${bgUrl}\u0027)`;\n\n      root.style.backgroundImage = bgValue;\n      root.style.backgroundSize = t.backgroundSize;\n      root.style.backgroundAttachment = \u0027fixed\u0027;\n      root.style.backgroundPosition = \u0027center\u0027;\n      root.style.backgroundRepeat = \u0027no-repeat\u0027;\n    } else {\n      root.style.backgroundImage = \u0027\u0027;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private darken(hex: string, amount: number): string {\n    const num = parseInt(hex.replace(\u0027#\u0027, \u0027\u0027), 16);\n    const r = Math.max(0, (num \u003e\u003e 16) - amount);\n    const g = Math.max(0, ((num \u003e\u003e 8) \u0026 0xff) - amount);\n    const b = Math.max(0, (num \u0026 0xff) - amount);\n    return `#${((r \u003c\u003c 16) | (g \u003c\u003c 8) | b).toString(16).padStart(6, \u00270\u0027)}`;\n  }\n\n  private lighten(hex: string, percent: number): string {\n    const num = parseInt(hex.replace(\u0027#\u0027, \u0027\u0027), 16);\n    const r = (num \u003e\u003e 16) \u0026 0xff;\n    const g = (num \u003e\u003e 8) \u0026 0xff;\n    const b = num \u0026 0xff;\n    const mix = (c: number) =\u003e Math.min(255, Math.round(c + (255 - c) * (percent / 100)));\n    return `#${((mix(r) \u003c\u003c 16) | (mix(g) \u003c\u003c 8) | mix(b)).toString(16).padStart(6, \u00270\u0027)}`;\n  }\n\n  // Helper para construir URLs completas de \"backgrounds\"\n      const filename = parts[3];\n      // Usar el endpoint del FileController\n      return `http://localhost:8081/api/files/${type}/${filename}`;\n    }\n    return path;\n  }\n}\n",
